chunks: They say: 'Why was not an angel sent down to him?' Had We sent an angel down, the matter would have been concluded, then they would not be reprieved.
ai.seo_question: Why did the disbelievers ask for an angel to be sent with the Prophet?
ai.summary: This verse highlights the Quraysh's demand for a visible angelic validator, which Allah rejects to preserve the test of faith through human agency. Scholarly tradition notes that the immediate presence of an angel would have terminated the period of worldly respite (hawl), leading to instant retribution rather than allowing time for repentance or reflection.
